newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Refugio gold mine closed til weekend.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Refugio gold mine closed til weekend.

text.p: Mining operations at Chile's Refugio gold pit should restart at the weekend once workers finish clearing deep snow from the open-cast mine which has been closed since Saturday, said a mine official.
"The mine has been practically cleared and we should start operations towards the weekend," Anibal Avendano, human resources manager at Refugio, told Reuters.
The mine's processing plant which produces metal dore has continued operating during the closure, although production has been lower than normal, said Avendano.
Bad weather last week left the pit, which lies at 4,700 meters above sea level, covered with over two meters of snow and forced the evacuation of miners to the lower base camp.
Refugio is owned equally by Canada's Bema Gold Corp and Amax Gold.
The mine processes 30,000 tonnes of mineral daily and is designed to produce 230,000 ounces of gold a year when running at full capacity.
Last week's bad weather cut highways throughout northern Chile, including the road to nearby state copper company Codelco's Salvador mine which was damaged by heavy rains and landslides.
